document.citation_as_assigned: IACS Common Structural Rules for Bulk Carriers and Oil Tankers (2019) Pt.1 Ch.5; IACS UR S7 (2010) Minimum longitudinal strength standard
document.subject_quantity: hull-girder ULS gamma_s M_sw + gamma_w M_wv <= M_u and the yield criterion sigma = M/Z <= sigma_y/gamma_R
document.prior_record: benchmarks/anchors/iacs-csr-w22.json (mission 14512) reached the same conclusion; this file refreshes the acquisition attempt for W23 and is the register the W23 criteria read

why_it_is_blocking: without the printed gamma table the utilisation is a unit-factor reference value and the admissible factor M_u/(M_sw+M_wv); no CSR compliance claim may be made from it

acquisition_attempts.action: python urllib.request.urlopen on https://iacs.org.uk/ and https://www.iacs.org.uk/resolutions/unified-requirements/ (timeout 6 s; curl to external hosts is blocked by the sandbox policy)
acquisition_attempts.result: HTTP 403 Forbidden from the sandbox proxy for both URLs; no retrievable full text
hits are the repository's own W22 anchor/report and TensorPapers manuscripts that cite the document; none contains a rule table, page locator or factor value
no match: no transcription of gamma_w anywhere in the corpus
no IACS publication in the environment; only software manuals and unrelated papers, plus repository code/tests that mention IACS for other quantities (ice torque)

factors.role: partial safety factor on the still-water bending moment M_sw
factors.clause_as_assigned: IACS CSR BC&OT (2019) Pt.1 Ch.5 hull-girder ULS load combination

factors.role: partial safety factor on the vertical wave bending moment M_wv
factors.clause_as_assigned: IACS CSR BC&OT (2019) Pt.1 Ch.5 hull-girder ULS load combination

factors.role: partial safety factor on the yield strength of the elastic (yield) check
factors.clause_as_assigned: IACS CSR BC&OT (2019) Pt.1 Ch.5 yield criterion sigma = M/Z <= sigma_y/gamma_R

substitutes_reported_instead: unit-factor utilisation gamma_s = gamma_w = 1, explicitly labelled a reference value
admissible factor gamma* = M_u/(M_sw + M_wv) per case
exact factor sensitivity: gamma_w_max = (M_u - M_sw)/M_wv at gamma_s = 1 (utilisation is linear in the factors)
what_would_unblock: an operator-deposited transcription of the CSR Pt.1 Ch.5 ULS factor table with clause number and page
or an authorised copy of UR S7 (2010) with the printed factor values

resolved.how: the documents were retrieved from the public IACS object store (https://iacs.s3.af-south-1.amazonaws.com) instead of www.iacs.org.uk; gamma_S = 1.0, gamma_W = 1.2 (scenario A) and 1.3 (scenario B) transcribed from Pt 1 Ch 5 Sec 2 Table 2, printed page 344
